	add = te_budget_expense_military_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_shipping_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_programmes_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_diplomacy_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_civil_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_construction_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_welfare_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_subsidies_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_subventions_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_government_losses_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_interest_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_additional_positive
	add = te_budget_expense_other_positive
}

te_budget_expense_root_cached_count = {
	value = scope:count_root
}

te_budget_expense_administration_group_display_rank = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_military > 0 scope:row_military > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_military }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_shipping > 0 scope:row_shipping > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_shipping }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_programmes > 0 scope:row_programmes > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_programmes }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_diplomacy > 0 scope:row_diplomacy > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_diplomacy }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_civil > 0 scope:row_civil > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_civil }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_construction > 0 scope:row_construction > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_construction }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_welfare > 0 scope:row_welfare > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_welfare }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_subsidies > 0 scope:row_subsidies > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_subsidies }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_subventions > 0 scope:row_subventions > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_subventions }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_government_losses > 0 scope:row_government_losses > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_government_losses }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_interest > 0 scope:row_interest > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_interest }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_additional > 0 scope:row_additional > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_additional }
	if = { limit = { scope:subtree_other > 0 scope:row_other > scope:row_administration_group } add = scope:subtree_other }
}
